receipts.citation: Holmgren AJ, Fenton CL, Thombley R, Soleimani H, Croci R, DeMasi O, Byron ME, Murray SG, Adler-Milstein JR, Yazdany J. "Ambient Artificial Intelligence Scribes and Physician Financial Productivity." *JAMA Netw Open* 2026;9(1):e2553233. doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2025.53233. PMID 41511775. Cohort study, UCSF, ~1.2 million ambulatory encounters, 1,565 physicians, January 2023 to April 2025; 698 adopters (44.6%). Adopters: +1.81 RVUs/week (5.8%), approximately $3,044 additional annual revenue per physician at 2025 Medicare rates; +0.80 encounters/week (2.8%); no difference in claim denial proportion. Author and institutional statements per UCSF DoC-IT release: the findings are initial evidence that AI scribes change how physicians code and bill, with the open question being whether gains reflect additional services or changed coding practice. Single health system; voluntary early adopters. Cited by CMS in the CY2027 PFS RFI (see ref. 25).
receipts.proves: Holmgren: +1.81 RVU/wk (5.8%), $3,044/yr, +0.80 encounters, no denial rise

receipts.citation: Invited commentary, "Ambient AI Scribes — What Is the Return on Investment?" *JAMA Netw Open* 2026;9(1):e2553238. doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2025.53238. Subscription fees of $200 to $600 per clinician per month at most health systems; notes incremental gains "could collectively offset subscription fees," and cautions that increased visit volume may expand in-basket workload and erode initial well-being gains.
receipts.proves: ROI commentary: $200-600/clinician/mo subscription; names 'coding arms race'

receipts.citation: Nong P, Neprash HT. "Unintended Consequences of Using Ambient Artificial Intelligence Scribes for Billing." *JAMA Health Forum* 2026;7(1):e255771. doi:10.1001/jamahealthforum.2025.5771. PMID 41511793. Free article; published 02JAN2026, the same day as ref. 21. Quoted remarks from Hannah Neprash, PhD (University of Minnesota School of Public Health), in "Exclusive Interview with the Researcher," NIHCM Foundation, https://nihcm.org/publications/exclusive-interview-with-the-researcher-hannah-neprash-on-ambient-ai-scribes. Analysis supported by the NIHCM Foundation Investigator-Initiated Research Grant Program; Neprash holds a 2026 NIHCM policy research grant titled "The Effect of Ambient AI Scribes on Productivity, Coding Intensity, and Spending." Note the price range given here ($300-500 per user per month) is narrower than the $200-600 range in ref. 22; both are cited as reported.
receipts.proves: Nong/Neprash: billing tools may raise spending; '$300-500/mo → pressure to increase visits'
